figure_views.notes: I saw the smooth blue curve begin at amplitude 0, reach +0.5 at quarter-cycle, cross 0 at half-cycle, reach −0.5 at three-quarter-cycle, and return to 0 at one full cycle. The lower axis is cycle progress (phase), not seconds. Chinese labels, fraction marks and dashed guides are readable, with no clipping or text overlap preventing understanding. This supports the distinction between progression through one cycle and amplitude.

I saw two clearly labelled student rows and three quiz columns holding 60/70/80 and 80/90/100. The horizontal dim=1 arrow corresponds to each-student averages [70,90]; the vertical dim=0 arrow corresponds to each-quiz averages [70,80,90]. Labels and values are fully readable, and the separate average outputs do not look like extra source scores. This clarified the sample/time axis notation used by the audio prerequisite.
